declaredIntent.summary: Implement Task 4 reproducible WIII performance characterization, then independently archive, PR, merge, and close it.

outOfScope: Scheduler, retry, cancellation, workflow-engine, agent-manager, provider transport, credential, release, tag, and provider-configuration behavior.
Runtime publication/cache changes, crash recovery, lifecycle timing, receipt reuse, verification routing, and enforcement threshold changes assigned to later Work Items.

sources.reason: Task 4 delivery boundary and measurement matrix.
V2 query and benchmark design constraints.
Existing V2 snapshot/query implementation exercised by the harness.
Existing WIII test conventions and fixtures.

riskAssessment.reason: The harness must produce truthful, reproducible local measurements without mutating repository runtime data or making unsupported performance guarantees.

reasons: A public benchmark protocol and generated evidence require standard verification.

executionDecision.reason: The benchmark boundary, profiles, and verification are sourced and locally executable.

preReviewWarnings: Review temporary-directory isolation, report completeness, reproducibility metadata, percentile calculation, and absence of an enforcement claim.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The benchmark report validator rejects a case with fewer than 30 samples or missing W/F/concurrency, cold/warm, environment, latency percentile, timeout, lock-wait, or bytes-written evidence.
The harness writes all generated workload data under a caller-provided temporary root and does not write .ai runtime files in the repository.
The committed baseline contains the W={1,100}, F={1,1000,2000}, concurrency={1,8,32,64} matrix with 30 samples for each declared profile and records environment metadata.
The interface reference describes the report shape, local-only limits, and no-guarantee interpretation.
The archived Outcome names the focused benchmark test command, affected WIII test command, required governance checks, merged PR URL, and ai-close-work-item receipt.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The V2 interface has no reproducible performance evidence describing workload, environment, concurrency, or distributional latency, so later scale and cache work lacks a truthful comparison baseline.
constraints: Use temporary directories for generated benchmark data and leave repository runtime data unchanged.
Record measured distributions and environment metadata; do not set or imply an enforcement threshold.
Exercise the V2 query shape from Task 3 without changing its production behavior.
Use the recorded user approval only for this Work Item's PR/merge and governed cleanup.
intent.rationale: A validated, source-controlled measurement protocol makes later scalability claims comparable while separating evidence collection from performance policy.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A malformed report case omits mandatory measurement evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Validation identifies the missing evidence and rejects the report.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A normal benchmark run uses temporary workload data.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A valid report is emitted while the repository .ai runtime tree remains unchanged.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The full declared workload matrix is generated.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Every W/F/concurrency/profile combination records 30 samples and required percentile/count fields.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused report-matrix test and committed baseline inspection.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized required actions and requested this authorization in every Contract; it is limited to this Work Item lifecycle.
